questions.q: For the death of which person must a priest make himself unclean?
questions.a: A priest should make himself unclean for the death of a very close relative.

questions.q: What restrictions were placed on the priests concerning their hair and beards?
questions.a: Priests were not allowed to shave their heads or the edges of their beards.

questions.q: What would happen to a priest’s daughter who defiled herself by becoming a prostitute?
questions.a: A priest’s daughter who disgraces her father by becoming a prostitute must be burned.

questions.q: What must a high priest avoid even if the dead person is his father or mother?
questions.a: A high priest must not make himself unclean by entering a place where there is a dead body, even if his father or mother has died.

questions.q: What kind of woman must the priest not marry?
questions.a: The priest must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman who is a prostitute.

questions.q: What kind of man did Yahweh not want to approach him to perform the offerings?
questions.a: Yahweh did not want any man with a bodily defect to approach him.

commentary.text: —As these priests were types of Christ, so all ministers must be followers of him, that their example may teach others to imitate the Saviour. Without blemish, and separate from sinners, He executed his priestly office on earth. What manner of persons then should his ministers be! But all are, if Christians, spiritual priests; the minister especially is called to set a good example, that the people may follow it. Our bodily infirmities, blessed be God, cannot now shut us out from his service, from these privileges, or from his heavenly glory. Many a healthful, beautiful soul is lodged in a feeble, deformed body. And those who may not be suited for the work of the ministry, may serve God with comfort in other duties in his church.
